== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|House{{!}}The House of Blades is a significant location that serves as a source of immense power for [[Valinhall Travelers]]. It functions as a repository from which these individuals can summon their weapons into the outside world, though [[Travelers]] located within [[the House]] itself are unable to call blades from external sources. The structure provides various physical enhancements and defensive capabilities, allowing a user to bolster their strength, accelerate healing, neutralize toxins, and resist physical strikes. However, it offers limited protection against mental assaults. House{{!}}The House contains several distinct areas, including an [[entry hall]] with weapon racks, a [[graveyard]], and private living quarters. It also serves as a rare neutral ground where individuals can meet without fear of being watched. The facility is subject to political and military importance, as controlling or destroying it is a strategic goal for those seeking to undermine [[Valinhall Travelers]].}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|House{{!}}The House of Blades serves as a faction engaged in conflict against the [[City of Light]]. Within this location, which features hallways and floors composed of neat squares of smoothly polished tile, [[Ilana]] might have found greater safety. During his journey, [[Indirial]] experienced a mental opening comparable to walking through [[the House]] of Blades while he was present in its hallways. Ultimately, the site functions as the sole neutral ground where [[Simon]], [[Alin]], and [[Leah]] are able to convene without observation.}}
